SELECT CAST(SUM(d.total_runs) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT m.id)
FROM matches AS m
JOIN deliveries AS d ON m.id = d.match_id

SELECT
  batter,
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN batsman_runs IN (4, 6) THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) / SUM(batsman_runs) AS boundary_percentage
FROM deliveries
GROUP BY batter
HAVING SUM(batsman_runs) >= 500
ORDER BY boundary_percentage DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM (
  SELECT batter
  FROM deliveries
  GROUP BY batter
  HAVING SUM(batsman_runs) >= 1000
)

SELECT bowler, COUNT(*) AS ball_count
FROM deliveries
WHERE extras_type IS NULL
   OR extras_type NOT IN ('wides', 'noballs')
GROUP BY bowler
ORDER BY ball_count DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT batter, SUM(batsman_runs) AS runs
FROM deliveries
GROUP BY match_id, batter
ORDER BY runs DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT m.winner AS team, COUNT(*) AS wins
FROM matches AS m
JOIN deliveries AS d
  ON m.id = d.match_id
WHERE d.inning = 1
  AND m.winner IS NOT NULL
  AND m.winner <> d.batting_team
GROUP BY m.id, m.winner
ORDER BY wins DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT SUM(total_runs) AS total_powerplay_runs
FROM deliveries
WHERE "over" BETWEEN 0 AND 5

SELECT
  batter,
  SUM(batsman_runs) AS runs
FROM deliveries
WHERE "over" BETWEEN 15 AND 19
GROUP BY batter
ORDER BY runs DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
  batter,
  100.0 * SUM(batsman_runs) / SUM(CASE WHEN extras_type IS NULL OR extras_type <> 'wides' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS strike_rate
FROM deliveries
GROUP BY batter
HAVING SUM(batsman_runs) >= 300
ORDER BY strike_rate DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
  bowler,
  6.0 * SUM(
    batsman_runs +
    CASE
      WHEN LOWER(extras_type) IN ('wides', 'noballs') THEN extra_runs
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) / SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN extras_type IS NULL OR LOWER(extras_type) NOT IN ('wides', 'noballs') THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS economy
FROM deliveries
GROUP BY bowler
HAVING SUM(
  CASE
    WHEN extras_type IS NULL OR LOWER(extras_type) NOT IN ('wides', 'noballs') THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END
) >= 1000
ORDER BY economy ASC
LIMIT 1

WITH bowling_stats AS (
  SELECT
    bowler,
    SUM(
      total_runs - CASE
        WHEN extras_type IN ('byes', 'legbyes') THEN extra_runs
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS runs_conceded,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN is_wicket = 1
         AND dismissal_kind NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field')
        THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS wickets
  FROM deliveries
  GROUP BY bowler
)
SELECT
  bowler,
  ROUND(1.0 * runs_conceded / wickets, 2) AS bowling_average
FROM bowling_stats
WHERE wickets >= 30
ORDER BY bowling_average ASC
LIMIT 1

WITH team_runs AS (
  SELECT
    m.season,
    d.batting_team AS team,
    SUM(d.total_runs) AS runs,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY m.season
      ORDER BY SUM(d.total_runs) DESC, d.batting_team
    ) AS rn
  FROM matches AS m
  JOIN deliveries AS d
    ON m.id = d.match_id
  GROUP BY m.season, d.batting_team
)
SELECT season, team, runs
FROM team_runs
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY season

WITH batter_stats AS (
  SELECT
    batter,
    SUM(batsman_runs) AS total_runs,
    COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) AS matches_batted_in
  FROM deliveries
  GROUP BY batter
)
SELECT
  batter,
  CAST(total_runs AS REAL) / matches_batted_in AS average_runs_per_match
FROM batter_stats
WHERE matches_batted_in >= 30
ORDER BY average_runs_per_match DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT d.batting_team AS winning_team,
       SUM(d.total_runs) AS runs
FROM deliveries AS d
JOIN matches AS m
  ON d.match_id = m.id
WHERE d.inning = 2
  AND d.batting_team = m.winner
GROUP BY d.match_id, d.batting_team
ORDER BY runs DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT bowler, COUNT(*) AS wicket_count
FROM deliveries
WHERE "over" BETWEEN 15 AND 19
  AND is_wicket = 1
  AND COALESCE(dismissal_kind, '') NOT IN (
    'run out',
    'retired hurt',
    'retired out',
    'obstructing the field'
  )
GROUP BY bowler
ORDER BY wicket_count DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
  d.batter,
  COUNT(*) AS balls_faced
FROM deliveries AS d
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM deliveries AS w
  WHERE w.player_dismissed = d.batter
)
GROUP BY d.batter
ORDER BY balls_faced DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN toss_decision = 'field' AND winner = toss_winner THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM matches

WITH team_matches AS (
  SELECT season, team1 AS team, winner
  FROM matches
  WHERE season = '2023'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT season, team2 AS team, winner
  FROM matches
  WHERE season = '2023'
),
team_stats AS (
  SELECT
    team,
    COUNT(*) AS matches_played,
    SUM(CASE WHEN winner = team THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wins
  FROM team_matches
  GROUP BY team
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
)
SELECT
  team,
  ROUND(100.0 * wins / matches_played, 2) AS win_percentage
FROM team_stats
ORDER BY win_percentage DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
  bowler,
  player_dismissed AS batter,
  COUNT(*) AS dismissal_count
FROM deliveries
WHERE is_wicket = 1
  AND dismissal_kind IN ('bowled', 'caught', 'lbw', 'stumped', 'caught and bowled', 'hit wicket')
GROUP BY bowler, player_dismissed
ORDER BY dismissal_count DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH first_innings_totals AS (
  SELECT
    d.match_id,
    SUM(d.total_runs) AS first_innings_total
  FROM deliveries AS d
  WHERE d.inning = 1
  GROUP BY d.match_id
),
successful_chases AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.match_id
  FROM deliveries AS d
  JOIN matches AS m
    ON m.id = d.match_id
  WHERE d.inning = 2
    AND d.batting_team = m.winner
)
SELECT AVG(f.first_innings_total)
FROM first_innings_totals AS f
JOIN successful_chases AS s
  ON f.match_id = s.match_id
SELECT (SELECT SUM(total_runs) FROM deliveries) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id) FROM matches)

SELECT 
  batter,
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN batsman_runs IN (4, 6) THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / SUM(batsman_runs) AS boundary_percentage
FROM deliveries
GROUP BY batter
HAVING SUM(batsman_runs) >= 500
ORDER BY boundary_percentage DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT batter FROM deliveries GROUP BY batter HAVING sum(batsman_runs) >= 1000)

SELECT bowler, COUNT(*) AS ball_countFROM deliveries
WHERE extras_type NOT IN ('wides', 'noballs') OR extras_type IS NULL
GROUP BY bowler
ORDER BY ball_count DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT batter, SUM(batsman_runs) AS total_runs 
FROM deliveries 
GROUP BY match_id, batter 
ORDER BY total_runs DESC 
LIMIT 1

SELECT winner, COUNT(*) AS wins
FROM matches
WHERE winner != '' 
  AND winner = (
      SELECT d.batting_team 
      FROM deliveries d 
      WHERE d.match_id = matches.id AND d.inning = 2 
      GROUP BY d.batting_team 
      ORDER BY SUM(d.total_runs) DESC LIMIT 1
  )
GROUP BY winner
ORDER BY wins DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT SUM(total_runs) FROM deliveries WHERE "over" BETWEEN 0 AND 5

SELECT batter, SUM(batsman_runs) AS runs
FROM deliveries
WHERE "over" BETWEEN 15 AND 19
GROUP BY batter
ORDER BY runs DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT batter, (SUM(batsman_runs) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN extras_type = 'wides' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END)) AS strike_rate
FROM deliveries
GROUP BY batter
HAVING SUM(batsman_runs) >= 300
ORDER BY strike_rate DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    bowler, 
    (SUM(total_runs - COALESCE(extra_runs, 0)) * 6.0) / COUNT(*) AS economy
FROM deliveries
WHERE extras_type IS NULL OR extras_type NOT IN ('wides', 'noballs')
GROUP BY bowler
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000
ORDER BY economy ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    bowler, 
    CAST(SUM(total_runs - COALESCE(extra_runs, 0)) AS REAL) / SUM(is_wicket) AS bowling_average
FROM deliveries
WHERE dismissal_kind NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field')
GROUP BY bowler
HAVING SUM(is_wicket) >= 30
ORDER BY bowling_average ASC
LIMIT 1

WITH team_season_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        m.season,
        d.batting_team AS team,
        SUM(d.total_runs) AS runs,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.season ORDER BY SUM(d.total_runs) DESC) as rnk
    FROM deliveries d
    JOIN matches m ON d.match_id = m.id
    GROUP BY m.season, d.batting_team
)
SELECT season, team, runs
FROM team_season_runs
WHERE rnk = 1
ORDER BY season

SELECT batter, CAST(SUM(batsman_runs) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) AS avg_runs
FROM deliveries
GROUP BY batter
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) >= 30
ORDER BY avg_runs DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT m.winner, SUM(d.total_runs) AS total_runs
FROM matches m
JOIN deliveries d ON m.id = d.match_id
WHERE m.result = 'wickets' AND d.inning = 2
GROUP BY m.id, m.winner
ORDER BY total_runs DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT bowler, COUNT(*) AS wicket_count
FROM deliveries
WHERE "over" BETWEEN 15 AND 19
  AND is_wicket = 1
  AND dismissal_kind NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field')
GROUP BY bowler
ORDER BY wicket_count DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT batter, COUNT(*) AS balls_faced 
FROM deliveries 
WHERE batter NOT IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT player_dismissed 
    FROM deliveries 
    WHERE player_dismissed IS NOT NULL
) 
GROUP BY batter 
ORDER BY balls_faced DESC 
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN toss_winner = winner AND toss_decision = 'field' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100) / COUNT(*) 
FROM matches

WITH match_counts AS (
    SELECT team, COUNT(*) AS matches_played
    FROM (
        SELECT team1 AS team FROM matches WHERE season = '2023'
        UNION ALL
        SELECT team2 AS team FROM matches WHERE season = '2023'
    )
    GROUP BY team
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
),
win_counts AS (
    SELECT winner AS team, COUNT(*) AS matches_won
    FROM matches
    WHERE season = '2023' AND winner IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY winner
)
SELECT m.team, (CAST(COALESCE(w.matches_won, 0) AS REAL) / m.matches_played) * 100 AS win_percentage
FROM match_counts m
LEFT JOIN win_counts w ON m.team = w.team
ORDER BY win_percentage DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT bowler, player_dismissed AS batter, COUNT(*) AS dismissal_count
FROM deliveries
WHERE is_wicket = 1 
  AND player_dismissed IS NOT NULL 
  AND dismissal_kind NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field')
GROUP BY bowler, player_dismissed
ORDER BY dismissal_count DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT avg(first_innings_total) FROM (
  SELECT d.match_id, sum(d.total_runs) AS first_innings_total
  FROM deliveries d
  JOIN matches m ON d.match_id = m.id
  WHERE d.inning = 1 AND m.winner = m.team2
  GROUP BY d.match_id
)
